title: Check quorum overlap constraints
statement:
Step 7 · Reliable writes

Quorum overlap is a building block: R+W>N ensures every read set overlaps every write set, and 2W>N ensures write sets overlap. These arithmetic constraints alone do not guarantee linearizability or resolve concurrent versions.

Build it

Return whether read/write counts are valid positive counts at most replicas and satisfy both overlap inequalities. replicas is positive.

Contract: Implement overlap using Python's standard library. Inputs satisfy the constraints stated here. Do not mutate the inputs. Use the provided helpers where present; they represent earlier steps.

Examples

Input: replicas = 3, reads = 2, writes = 2
Expected: true
Input: replicas = 3, reads = 1, writes = 2
Expected: false
Hint

Validate counts first, then check both strict inequalities.

Review your understanding

Why can sloppy quorums, conflicting versions, or membership changes invalidate a naive consistency claim?

Explain your reasoning in Notes before opening the worked solution. Passing the local checks completes this exercise; it does not certify production readiness or evaluate your design explanation.
